about:
Cable Technology Inc was established in June 1982 in Willington, Connecticut, for the purpose of manufacturing plastic-insulated wire and cable for the electronic industry. The founding aimed to supply the growing electronics sector with reliable hook-up wire and multi-conductor cable solutions.

The company manufactures hook-up wire and multi-conductor cables, leveraging the manufacturing expertise of its personnel and the continued upgrading of operations through more sophisticated equipment. This approach has earned Cable Technology a reputation as a technological factor in the wire and cable industry, with a focus on meeting evolving customer requirements.

The company's products serve computers, data processing equipment, medical electronics, automotive systems, and various military, instrumentation, and control applications. These markets reflect the breadth of electronic and industrial sectors that rely on plastic-insulated wire and cable assemblies built to military specifications.

Cable Technology states that its manufacturing expertise combined with ongoing equipment investment sets it apart, enabling the company to meet growing customer requirements across diverse electronic and industrial applications.
